newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares end at new high, record run to go on.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares end at new high, record run to go on.

text.p: The Danish top-20 KFX share index closed at an all-time record high for the tenth consecutive trading day on Monday and dealers predicted that the record run would continue.
"We climbed today despite bond falls. We should rise by another half percentage point tomorrow, " one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 0.76 point higher at 186.10 in overall bourse turnover of 1.640 billion crowns. The KFX August future rose 1.55 point to 187.40 with 482 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Banks slipped after a week of solid advances with Den Danske losing eight crowns to finish at 742 and rival Unidanmark shedding five crowns to 438. In contrast BG Bank put on three crowns to end up at 400.

The strong dollar helped Novo Nordisk to climb 16 crowns to close at 750, while Moeller was mixed, with D/S Svendborg losing 1,000 crowns to finish at 394,000 and twin D/S 1912 paper rising 5,000 to 275,000.
